name: Retriggerable monostable
summary: Produces a timed output pulse that can be extended by a qualifying retrigger condition.
description: Produces a timed output pulse that can be extended by a qualifying retrigger condition.

On a schematic, identify the trigger polarities, clear input and timing components and trace the pulse/complemented outputs and timed control use. Keep the component tag and signal/reference names consistent across the control drawing, terminal schedule and device documentation.
A retriggerable one-shot differs from a non-retriggerable pulse generator or a free-running oscillator.
